Authenticated/account-only surfaces, uploads, checkout, private media, albums, community member areas, and destructive account actions were not covered because no credentials were provided and representative public templates already covered the primary anonymous journeys.

paths.description: Homepage and latest-video listing, representing the primary browse journey.
Category index, representing taxonomy and listing navigation.
Public video detail/player, representing the primary content-consumption template.
Login form, representing authentication and form validation.
Unknown route, representing HTTP failure and recovery behavior.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Light and dark screenshots are byte-identical, and the CSS probe found no color-scheme or prefers-color-scheme rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-responsive surface, text, and control colors.

findings.summary: A body fade remains active under reduced-motion.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe matched reduce but still reported body transition: 0.3s; CSS contains no reduced-motion override.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential transitions and animations inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Important text does not meet minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found contrast failures including 2.62:1 red text on #151515 and multiple gray-on-black labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise text and control contrast and verify normal and increased-contrast modes.

findings.summary: Full-page navigation has no continuity treatment.
findings.evidence: CSS/DOM probe found no View Transition usage across an MPA with repeated header and listing/detail navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-origin cross-document View Transitions with a safe fallback.

findings.summary: Long listing pages provide no scroll progress or state cue.
findings.evidence: The homepage is 6,608px tall on mobile and the CSS probe found no scroll timeline or equivalent progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight compositor-driven scroll progress cue where it helps orientation.

findings.summary: The long browse page offers no scroll-state-aware navigation.
findings.evidence: A 6,608px mobile listing retains static chrome, with no scroll-state query or progress behavior in the probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a scroll-aware compact header or progress affordance without obscuring content.

findings.summary: Menus and search popovers use legacy custom positioning.
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM uses data-toggle="popover" and custom dropable elements; no Popover API or CSS anchor-positioning signal was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic popovers and CSS anchor positioning with position-try fallbacks.

findings.summary: The cookie banner obscures primary content on every tested mobile path.
findings.evidence: Mobile screenshots show a fixed consent banner covering cards, form footer, or player metadata before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-obscuring consent surface with equivalent choices and reserve space when shown.

findings.summary: Dismissible UI is built from custom anchors and divs.
findings.evidence: The consent action is an <a> without href and positive tabindex; probe found zero dialog or popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use button, dialog, and popover primitives with semantic dismissal and focus behavior.

findings.summary: Chrome and overlays consume too much of the first mobile viewport.
findings.evidence: The header reaches roughly 214px and the fixed cookie banner covers the bottom ~116px of an 800px viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse non-primary header content and keep consent controls compact.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch target support are inadequate.
findings.evidence: The focused link computed outline is none 0px; probe counted 18 visible targets below 24px and Lighthouse failed target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Add clear :focus-visible styles and at least 24px targets with adequate spacing.

findings.summary: The login flow’s verification widget throws a runtime error.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse on /login recorded an uncaught TurnstileError for an invalid or missing sitekey parameter while the screenshot remained at “Verifying…”.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct the Turnstile integration and test successful and failed authentication end to end.

findings.summary: Form errors and recovery state are not announced accessibly.
findings.evidence: The login probe found zero aria-live/alert regions; fields omit required and aria-invalid, while native pattern messages only appear after synthetic values.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark required fields, set aria-invalid after interaction, and announce specific errors in a live region.

findings.summary: Cold-load LCP is slow on primary pages.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured homepage LCP 8.2s and login LCP 5.5s, despite low TBT and CLS.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, remove blocking dependencies, and defer non-essential third parties.

findings.summary: The homepage over-fetches and blocks rendering.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 184 requests and 3.70MB transferred; multiple parser-inserted stylesheets and classic scripts are high-priority render-blocking candidates confirmed in DOM.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline critical CSS, defer scripts, consolidate fonts, and gate ad/media fetching until needed.

findings.summary: A large share of shipped JS and CSS is unused.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 262KiB unused JavaScript and 17KiB unused CSS on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split page-specific bundles and remove duplicate/unused analytics and UI code.

findings.summary: Interactive controls and frames lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found the mobile menu button, pagination link, and multiple iframes without accessible names or titles.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control an accessible name and every meaningful iframe a title.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails WCAG thresholds.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported multiple 2.62:1 to 4.49:1 foreground/background combinations on all tested templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Use tested color tokens that meet 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text/UI.

findings.summary: Landmarks and focus order are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found no main landmark and positive tabindex values 1 and 2; focus probe showed no visible outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <main>, preserve DOM-order focus, remove positive tabindex, and style :focus-visible.

findings.summary: Small muted text is difficult to read.
findings.evidence: Screenshots and Lighthouse show 9–12px gray labels and footer links on black, several with insufficient contrast.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase minimum text size/line-height and use higher-contrast muted text tokens.

findings.summary: The viewport disables zoom and many targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: meta viewport contains user-scalable=no; Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and target-size on home and login.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no, preserve 200%+ zoom/reflow, and enlarge targets.

findings.summary: The login page logs an uncaught verification exception.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured an uncaught Cloudflare TurnstileError on /login.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix sitekey initialization and add monitoring/tests that keep the console clean.

findings.summary: The page triggers browser issues and prevents bfcache.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed Inspector Issues and reported 17 bfcache failure reasons on home, including no-store responses and WebSocket use.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve DevTools Issues and avoid unnecessary no-store/WebSocket behavior on public browse pages.

findings.summary: Some controls are non-crawlable anchors and zoom is disabled.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors for the href-less consent action and meta-viewport for user-scalable=no; the DOM probe counted three anchors without href.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons for actions, hrefs for navigation, and a zoom-safe viewport declaration.

findings.summary: The advertised sitemap endpoint is missing.
findings.evidence: robots.txt returned 200, but /sitemap.xml returned HTTP 404 with an HTML error body.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a valid XML sitemap and reference it from robots.txt; retain accurate canonicals/statuses.

findings.summary: Structured and social metadata is incomplete or malformed.
findings.evidence: Probe found zero JSON-LD blocks; homepage og:image is only “https:”, og:description is empty, and video dimensions are empty.
findings.suggestedFix: Add valid VideoObject/Breadcrumb JSON-LD and complete Open Graph/Twitter metadata.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie transport flags are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers lack CSP and nosniff; cookies probe found PHPSESSID and analytics cookies without Secure; Lighthouse saw two HTTP ad beacons upgraded to HTTPS.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash CSP and nosniff, mark session cookies Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite, and remove HTTP endpoints.

findings.summary: Tracking starts before meaningful consent across a very large third-party surface.
findings.evidence: Trackers found 19 third-party origins; HAR attributes 156 requests and 3.67MB to third parties, including GTM, Yandex and ad networks, while only “Got it” is offered.
findings.suggestedFix: Block non-essential third parties until granular consent and reduce analytics/ad data collection.

findings.summary: Authentication lacks modern credential assistance.
findings.evidence: Login fields omit autocomplete tokens and the DOM contains no passkey/WebAuthn flow despite browser support.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete=username/current-password and offer passkey authentication as an enhancement.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete.
findings.evidence: CSP, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent; 12 cookies were flagged for insecure or SameSite=None behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Set restrictive CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and hardened cookie attributes.

findings.summary: A third-party verification failure is not handled gracefully.
findings.evidence: The login widget stays in verification while Lighthouse records an uncaught TurnstileError, with no accessible fallback state.
findings.suggestedFix: Catch widget failures and provide retry/fallback authentication while preserving entered data and focus.

findings.summary: Unknown routes produce a soft 404.
findings.evidence: A deliberately unknown URL returned HTTP 200 and rendered the homepage instead of a clear not-found state and recovery choices.
findings.suggestedFix: Return HTTP 404 with a focused not-found page, search, and links back to useful sections.

findings.summary: The document language is set but layout CSS is not direction-ready.
findings.evidence: Probe found html lang=en but no dir and no logical-property signals in loaded CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS logical properties and ensure dir can be set for bidirectional/localized content.

findings.summary: Relative time and large counts appear as hard-coded English formatting.
findings.evidence: Rendered cards use strings such as “3 hours ago” and raw count formatting, with no locale-aware formatting evidence in the page DOM/CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Format dates, relative times, and counts with Intl APIs using the active locale.

findings.summary: Consent offers acceptance but no equivalent rejection or preference choice.
findings.evidence: The fixed banner states continued use implies agreement and exposes only “Got it” plus Learn more, while trackers already run.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide equally prominent accept/reject/manage choices and delay non-essential processing until choice.

findings.summary: Login validation relies on terse browser pattern errors and lacks announced recovery.
findings.evidence: Fields are not required, have no aria-invalid, and there are no live regions; invalid values yield generic “Please match the format requested.”
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after interaction, explain requirements beside fields, and announce errors without clearing input.

findings.summary: Login fields omit autocomplete semantics.
findings.evidence: Username and password inputs returned empty autocomplete values.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete=username and autocomplete=current-password; keep password-manager paste/autofill paths unobstructed.

findings.summary: The account entry flow lacks resilient verification and modern reauthentication support.
findings.evidence: The unauthenticated login flow is blocked by a Turnstile exception and exposes no passkey option.
findings.suggestedFix: Repair verification, support password managers/passkeys, and test recovery before exposing account actions.

findings.summary: Images are not responsively or format optimized.
findings.evidence: Images audit found 40 without srcset, 14 legacy-format images, no modern-format img sources, and 34 below-fold images without native lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP responsive sources with srcset/sizes and native lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: The homepage performs substantial idle/background network work.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 42 fetch/XHR requests and three MP4 fetches, including 2.47MB from one media CDN before the user selected content.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not preload feed videos; defer ad/analytics work until consent and user proximity/intent.

findings.summary: Third-party and media transfer dominates the page budget.
findings.evidence: Of 3.70MB transferred, 3.67MB and 156 requests were third-party; individual MP4 requests reached 1.15MB and 0.79MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set explicit page/third-party budgets, lazy-load media, and remove low-value ad/analytics vendors.

findings.summary: Search and account capabilities have no machine-readable agent interface.
findings.evidence: Probe found no WebMCP/tool registration; Lighthouse agentic-browsing score was 0.33 and reported a malformed accessibility tree.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose safe search/navigation actions through semantic forms and, where appropriate, WebMCP tools.
